322	beings. This is what is meant by "all the life of this world": better one hour
323	of contentment of spirit in the World to Come than all the life of this world.
324	"Contentment of spirit" is when you haven't yet entered Gan Eden, just a little
325	of the aroma from outside, of what happens in there.
326	In Jerusalem there is the Angel bakery. Whoever walks
327	by the bakery usually walks more slowly.
328	How pleasant it is there. That is called contentment of spirit. Better one hour
329	of contentment of spirit in the World to Come than all the life of this world.
330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What is
331	the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of illusion. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with our eyes. But
334	the truth is that matter is a kind of illusion.
335	Even science is beginning to understand this. They know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, which are tiny particles
337	all packed together, one next to
338	the other. On the tip of a pin, how many atoms are there at the very
339	finest point? How many atoms are there? You'd have to write the number
340	three and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the tip of a pin. And what is each atom made of?
342	A nucleus inside, with electrons spinning around it
343	at great speed, and they create the illusion of a shell. Like
344	a fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disc. The disc is an illusion. It
346	looks like a solid atom, but it is not solid, only
347	because of the speed. Electrons moving at speed
348	create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	upon billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	moving? What would happen? The entire universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the real matter of the whole planet
354	Earth could fit inside a matchbox. That is the
355	real matter that exists; all the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of... Since matter is imagination, say the masters of
357	the Kabbalah, the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
358	imagination. In the material world, when a person enjoys, it is a kind of
359	imagination, but he enjoys it because it suits matter.
